metadata.description: A consumable composition: an orderable unit assembled from other classes and references, declared once and realized many times. The Base Class carries only the composition MECHANISM — the sovereignty floor the whole must hold, and the non-isolating groupings its realized parts join. It declares no constituents, because a Base Class states what a composition is rather than what any particular composition contains. outputs-exempt: a Template is a definition realized many times; the composite it realizes carries the outputs.

zone.description: The SovereigntyZone this composition must be placed within — a reference to a `Knowledge/SovereigntyZone` record, which declares what the coined zone name means in ISO 3166 terms so the residency-subsumption match is computable rather than assumed. Never a bare coined string: a name without a declared meaning gives an auditor no answer.

classification.description: The data-classification floor the placement must satisfy. The vocabulary is a free string today and should be a governed one — the same hole `zone` had before its class existed, tracked at #472 — so a peer reading `restricted` learns only the word.

cohesion.description: same_zone = every constituent must land in ONE zone satisfying the floor, a JOINT constraint over the placement set. per_constituent = each satisfies the floor independently. No default: which one applies is the composition author's decision and UDLM ships no defaults (NDF-001).

sovereignty_floor.description: The sovereignty requirement this composition must hold, carried as immutable data and communicated to whoever decides admission (ADR-057 — UDLM codifies, does not vet). Realized onto each constituent's `sovereignty` block at placement. A joint constraint is evaluable only once every placement is known, which is why placement sits inside the convergence loop rather than after it: a cohesion failure must RE-PLACE, and that is another iteration, not a post-placement correction.

groupings.description: Additional NON-isolating groupings the realized constituents join — cost center, project, business unit. References Grouping records under advisory enforcement, where a member may belong to many. Deliberately NOT the System's own grouping, which derives from the composite's uuid and is never stored (DRV-001), and deliberately NOT a tenant: a tenant boundary is an isolation border carried on the realized entity's `tenant_uuid`, never chosen by a Template.

context.purpose: Declares a consumable composition — the mechanism by which an orderable unit is assembled from other classes and references, declared once and realized many times.
context.plain_description: The thing on a menu that is made of other things. The Base carries only the composition mechanism: the sovereignty floor every realization must sit within, and the groupings a realization joins. What it composes is on the Type (Template.Application and kin).
use_when: You need the composition floor without saying what kind of thing is composed.
not_for: An application stack — that is Template.Application.
A single resource — order its class directly.
works_with: Template.Application — the Type that says what is composed.
